corrections.reason: The printed text reads 'ምዕመናንም' (plural 'believers' with 4th-order ና followed by 6th-order ን), which was transposed as 'ምዕመንናም'.
The printed glyph is ሣ (ይነሣሉና with ሠ-series ሣ), misread as ሳ.
Both visually in the type and in standard Ge'ez orthography ('ቈጽለ ዕፀ ዘይት'), the character is ጽ rather than ፅ.
The printed text has the Amharic ideophonic compound 'ቍንጥጥ አድርጎ ይዞታል' (6th-order ቍ and 6th-order ጥ), misread as 'ቈንጥጦ'.
The printed text clearly reads 'የማኅበሩን ለመግለጽ ነው' (to reveal the communion/unity of the Trinity), where 'በሩ' was misread as 'ፀኑ'.
